title: 17673 - 17673/P1266/004710
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to PD Unit Injector: Cylinder 3 (N242) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to PD Unit Injector: Cylinder 3 (N242)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  PD Unit Injector: Cylinder 3 (N242)
Kontrol edin:  Camshaft for Signs of wear
technicalNotes: Injectors on TDI PD/PPD Engines are not designed to run Waste Vegetable Oil (WVO) or Straight Vegetable Oil (SVO) as well as anything above 5% Biodiesel Content. Running these Types of Fuels can Damage the Injectors. Please Refer to the Owners Manual and/or Factory Repair Manual for a list of appropriate Fuel Types.
